input.text: So I've been watching the river all morning from my place near Oak and 3rd and it's way higher than 2019, I'd say 3 feet above the marker. Nothing flooded on our block yet though. Also saw a fire truck heading south on 3rd st about 10 min ago.

reasons: River 3ft above marker but no flooding yet
Fire truck sighting unconfirmed as incident
